book.name: 1 Thessalonians
book.title: 1 Thessalonians Saint Paul, Thessalonica gwizhit Gwik'injiighit Nąįį Tr'ookit ts'ą' Ch'adąąntł'oo

content: K'eegwaadhat Naaheedyaa Eenjit Shreegadhoh'ąįį
Shijyaa nąįį, nijin ji' K'eegwaadhat Jesus nineeheedyaa geenjit nakhwats'ą' ch'adareheentł'oo ts'ą' nakhwaa gwarahaandak geenjit diinaa gwik'it goo'aii kwaa
Jii jyaa digwinyąą gwinzii gaakhwandaii geh'an K'eegwaadhat needyaa ji', nijin ch'ihłee gaa gineeyuulii kwaa gwiizhit, dinjii ch'an'įį tǫǫ neech'ahaan'ik k'it neeheedyaa t'inchy'aa.

Nijin dinjii nąįį “Jii nankat gwik'eerahtii ts'ą' tsinehdan goo'aii,” ginyąą gwiizhit, khan hee goovaagwigweheetrii nagwahaadhal, tr'injaa tr'iinin haa iłts'ik naanaii k'it. Duuyeh jii googwantrii gwats'an tr'igijyaa t'oonchy'aa.

Gaa shijyaa nąįį, jii nankat tr'agwaanduu t'igii'in haa tǫǫ goo'aii k'it t'oonchy'aa gwats'an ǫhłįį kwaa. Ąįįts'ą' zhat drin nijin K'eegwaadhat goorahtee dinjii ch'an'įį k'it nineezhii ji' diinankat gwidinjii nąįį k'it nakhwarahtee t'igweheenjyaa kwaa t'oonchy'aa.
Datthak ts'ą' adrii ts'ą' drin haa gwats'an ǫhłįį. Khaa ts'ą' tǫǫ haa gwats'an tr'iinlii kwaa t'oonchy'aa.
Ąįįts'ą' t'ee juu iłchųų nąįį k'it t'aroochy'a' shrǫ', deegweheenjyaa gaagwiindaii kwaa gaa gwik'eerohti' ts'ą' deegwii'in chan gwik'eerohti'.
Juu iłchųų nąįį tǫǫ hee giłchųų, ts'ą' juu ch'iinįį nąįį tǫǫ hee ch'igiinįį.

Drin gwats'an tr'iinlii geh'an deegwii'in gwik'eerahtii, niveet'ah'in ch'iitsii chyah dril didrihtsii naazhii k'it diigwik'injigwiighit ts'ą' ch'eet'igwiniindhan haa dik'eerahtii geenjit vit'injiraahchy'aa. Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa neediihahshii geenjit vit'injarahchy'aa, ąįį haa niveet'ah'in goots'eenaraa'aii k'it t'oonchy'aa.
Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa, diinaa gwagwantrii haa khaiinjich'ireheeghit geenjit gwitee tr'idiiniinlii kwaa, gaa K'eegwaadhat Jesus Christ vik'iighai' neereheezhii geenjit.
Ąįįts'ą' niriindhat akwat gwarandaii, ji' datthak vaa t'igweheechy'aa ąįį geenjit Jesus diineenjit niindhat t'oonchy'aa.
Gwandaa gwinzii t'akhwa'in nihtł'ohnyąą ts'ą' t'aih nihts'an ohtsii, ąįį gwik'it t'akhwa'in tseenjyaa nihts'ą' jyaa dakhwa'in.
Nats'ąą Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa Shoo Tr'ahahtsyaa Ąįį Paul Jyaa Dakhwa'in nyąą.
Shijyaa nąįį, it'ee juk juu nakhwatee gwintł'oo gwitr'it t'agwah'in nąįį khadhoo'ee, juu K'eegwaadhat zhit nakhwakhaihkwaii nilii nąįį, ts'ą' tr'agwaanduu t'akhwa'in kwaa nakhwahnyąą nąįį t'aihnyąą.
Gwintł'oo gwitr'it t'agwagwah'in geh'an gwintł'oo gookhadhoo'ee ts'ą' gooveenjit ch'eet'igwiniindhan akhwa'įį. Tsinehdan zhit nihłaa t'ohchy'aa.

Diijyaa nąįį datthak jyaa goovohnyąą juu tr'agoodiinjik nąįį gwitr'it t'agoh'in goovohnyąą ts'ą' naajat nąįį chan noojat kwaa goovohnyąą, juu vat'aii kwaa nąįį chan ts'ohnyaa ts'ą' juu nąįį datthak haa khadhoochį' kwaa ts'ą' dinjii ǫhłįį.
Nakhwatee ch'ihłee dinjii ts'ą' gwiizųų t'iizhik ji' yats'ą' k'eegwiichy'aa t'oo'ya' shrǫ', gaa khit nihłeenjit ts'ą' juu nąįį datthak haa nakhweeshroonchy'aa.
Khit nakhwaa shroonchy'aa,
gweedhaa datthak khagadǫhjii,
Gwiizųų akwat gwinzii haa datthak geenjit Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa mahsį' vohnyąą, ji' t'ee Christ Jesus k'iighai' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa jyaa dakhwa'ya' nakhoonyaa t'oonchy'aa.
Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa Vach'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą nakhwatee tr'agwah'in ąįį goots'į' t'ohchy'a' shrǫ'.
Nijin ch'izhii gwik'injiighit nąįį Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą shats'ą' gwigweełkįį ginyąą dąį' akhagavohnyą' shrǫ'!
Gaa jidii datthak gwinzii t'iginyąą ji' geenjit gwinzii gooh'in, ąįį gwik'iighai' łyaa t'iginyąą gaahahkhwandaii geenjit, gwinzii t'iginyąą ji' ąįį gǫhtą'.
Jidii tr'aanduu datthak akhohnyąą, tr'agwaanduu t'iginyąą łee ji' gwik'eegǫhthat shrǫ'.
Paul Khaiinkǫǫ Goots'ą' Ch'adąąntł'oo Dąį' Gooveiinyą'

Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa, tsinehdan gwats'ąnh ąhtsii, ąįį shroodiinyąą datthak nohtsyaa. K'eegwaadhat Jesus Christ nineeheedyaa gwats'ą' nizhin, nanky'aa, ts'ą' natthąį' haa tr'agwaanduu gwitr'it t'agwahah'yaa gwits'į' nat'aii goh'į'.
Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa gwitee tr'anąąhchįį t'ee deehee'yaa nyąą gwik'it t'ihee'yaa t'inchy'aa.
Diijyaa nąįį, diineenjit chan khagadǫhjii.
Nakhwachaa nąįį gwik'injiighit zhit, nǫh'in dąį' gooyineedohtrat, ts'ą' diineenjit nakhwadivee doonchy'aa goovohnyąą.
Jii dęhtły'aa K'eegwaadhat vat'aii k'iighai' nakhwachaa gwik'injiighit zhit nąįį haa nǫh'in.
Diik'eegwaadhat Jesus Christ vich'eegoonzhrii nakhwaa oolį'.
